name: study-brief
title: Research study brief
for_each: select id,title from studies order by code

sections.title: Scope
sections.sql: select code,title,purpose,owner,review_due from studies where id=$1

sections.title: Findings ready for review
sections.note: Only approved findings with current source reviews appear. This is an internal review document, not permission to distribute participant data.
sections.sql: select title,summary,approved_by,approved_on,contradictions from approved_findings where study_id=$1 order by title

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select f.title as finding,n.title as source,n.participant,c.stance,c.quote,n.source_url from approved_findings f join citations c on c.finding_id=f.id join note_checks n on n.id=c.note_id where f.study_id=$1 and n.usable and position(c.quote in n.body)>0 order by f.title,n.title

name: decision-record
title: Research decision record
for_each: select id,title from decisions order by due_on

sections.title: Basis
sections.sql: select f.title,f.summary,f.approved_by,f.approved_on from approved_findings f join decisions d on d.finding_id=f.id where d.id=$1
